summary_for_children: An-Nisa teaches fairness to everyone, kindness to family, orphans and neighbours, and returning what we are trusted with.
world_title: The Village of Trusts and Justice
environment_concept: A village of trusts and justice: a square with one fountain from which channels run (4:1), houses waiting for what was lent to come back (4:58), a lane of neighbours (4:36) and tall scales (4:135).
architecture_and_scenery: Whitewashed village houses, a well, a market square with large balance scales, family courtyards.

areas.name: Square of One Soul
areas.description: A square with a single fountain from which many channels flow.

areas.name: House of Trusts
areas.description: Houses each waiting for something they lent to come back.

areas.name: Neighbours' Lane
areas.description: A lane where children help neighbours near and far.

areas.name: Scales of Justice
areas.description: Great balance scales that tip when something unfair is placed.

activities.name: Return the trusts
activities.description: Carry four chests back to the house they belong to.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Keep the scales level
activities.description: Choose fair options so the scales stay balanced, then read 4:135.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator explains each value with everyday examples, clearly as explanation, then reads the ayah.
learning_objectives: Name people the Quran asks us to be kind to

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (scale, spring, village) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

adventure_world.title: The Village of Fairness
adventure_world.source: "Quran Adventure: First 10 Unique Worlds" with the rule "114 unique game experiences" (2026-11-04); replaces the first adventure version built from the earlier design table
adventure_world.status: second version built for the web: each world now has its own core mechanic; draft, unreviewed; checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL only, not on phones or real GPUs
adventure_world.note: The new-look adventure world for this surah. It is a separate design from the composed scene this record describes; both are kept until reviewers choose.
adventure_world.core_play: A decision game: share limited stores among households with different needs, and watch the village show the result. Splitting everything evenly is not the fair answer here.

unique_world.visual_theme: Winter village of six homes, lamps in windows

primary_mechanic.text: Share grain, blankets and wood among six homes by what each needs; an even split fails, and lamps light where needs are met.

unique_world.learning_objective: Fairness means giving what is due, which is not always the same share
